privacyIntro: Protection of your data is very important to us! Here we explain simply and clearly how we handle information.
privacyStorageText:
We only store:
- Your player name (nickname is enough!)
- Your scores

These data are stored exclusively in the local storage of your own browser. They never leave your computer or device.
privacyNameCheckText: No. We removed the automated check. Your name is saved only on your device and is never sent to any server.
privacyTrackingText:
We use:
- No cookies
- No web analytics
- No advertising
- No social media plugins
We do not track users.
privacyChildText: This app is made for kids. There are no external links, no chat, and no data sharing.
privacyLegalText:
